answer: Unannounced re-performance checks make sybil farming expensive. Every alias must redo one randomly sampled past task live for every 20 tasks it completes, within 24 hours, under the same scoring rules as the first run. The sample can be a walnut sorting job, a terrace survey, or a copper inventory count, so an operator cannot predict which alias or which task gets called. An alias that refuses, misses the window, or scores below 70 percent on the redo loses its full reputation balance and stays locked for 14 epochs, and every alias sharing its device fingerprint is locked with it.
